Class PlayerController

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.PlayerController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/player") public class PlayerController extends Object
JSON API through which the browser player talks to the per-session MusicPlayerService.

The browser plays audio itself; these endpoints keep the server-side queue, next/previous decisions and play tracking in step. Every state-returning endpoint answers with a PlayerController.PlayerState. A song whose file is missing yields a 404 whose reason is the desktop error text so the UI can show it as a toast.

SRP: translates HTTP requests to service calls and entities to JSON-safe records.

DIP: depends on the session-scoped service through its injected proxy.

Time Complexity: O(1) per request except queue replacement, O(n).

Space Complexity: O(n) for a queue of n ids.

      @PostMapping("/queue") public PlayerController.PlayerState queue(@RequestBody PlayerController.QueueRequest request)

    • queueLibrary

      @PostMapping("/queue/library") public PlayerController.PlayerState queueLibrary()
      Replaces the queue with a shuffled copy of the whole library.

      The desktop Recently Played panel queued every song in the library before playing the row that was double-clicked, so playback carries on through the library afterwards. Building the queue on the server saves the browser from having to know every song id.

      Time Complexity: O(n) for a library of n songs.

      Returns:
      the state after the change
